# Minnesota Statute 124D.111 - Free School Meals Provisions

## Subdivision 1c - Free School Meals Program

Schools participating in the USDA National School Lunch Program must "provide to all students at no cost up to two federally reimbursable meals per school day, with a maximum of one free breakfast and one free lunch."

The statute requires participation in both the USDA School Breakfast Program and National School Lunch Program to participate in the free meals program.

## Subdivision 1d - State Aid Amount

The state provides funding to participating schools based on the difference between the applicable federal reimbursement rate for a free meal and the actual federal reimbursement received. Specifically, "The state aid equals the difference between the applicable federal reimbursement rate at that school site for a free meal...and the actual federal reimbursement received by the participating school for the breakfast or lunch served to the student."

Schools can receive aid for up to one breakfast and one lunch per student daily.
